name: Hot Honey Tofu Fingers & Blue Cheese Wedge Salad with Herby Ranch
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Place bread crumbs and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the coating.
Place mayo, soy sauce, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine.
Cut tofu crosswise into 1-inch wide fingers. Add to the bowl with the mayo mixture and gently toss to coat. (Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels and reserve for the next step.)

Add bread crumb coating to the bowl with the tofu and gently toss once more to coat. Transfer tofu to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer; drizzle with oil. (Reserve small bowl for later use.)
Place tofu in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and warmed through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place honey, hot sauce, and salt in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the hot honey and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Roughly chop chives. Add half to the blender along with yogurt, mayo, and spices. Blend on high until herby ranch dressing is smooth; set aside. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
Trim and cut romaine into quarters lengthwise, to make 4 wedges.
Halve grape tomatoes lengthwise. Season with salt.
Divide tofu fingers and romaine wedges between plates. Top wedges with dressing, tomatoes, blue cheese, and remaining chives. Serve with hot honey for dipping tofu. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
